senses.definition: n.[m.] desert-plateau, steppe (cf. CheIntr. Is. 129);—בַּעֲרָ֑ב בַּעֲרַב (si vera l.) Is 21:13(×2) in the steppe (of what we know as N. Arabia); but in vb Vrss Lo Che Gu Kau al. בָּעֶרֶב in the evening.
